| # Object 0x1800 to 0x1807 transmit PDO communication parameters {#object-0x1800-to-0x1807-transmit-pdo-communication-parameters-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This object contains the communication parameters of the current PDO the device is able to transmit.

 

+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Index                             | 0x1800 to 1807                    |
+===================================+===================================+
| Description                       | TPDO x Communication parameter    |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Object Code                       | RECORD                            |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Data Type                         | PDO CommPar                       |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Category                          | Conditional;                      |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | Mandatory for each supported PDO  |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+

 

 

SubIndex Supported

 

  SubIndex        0
  --------------- ----------------------------
  Description     largest subIndex supported
  Access          RO
  Default Value   2
  Range           NA

 

+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| SubIndex                          | 1                                 |
+===================================+===================================+
| Description                       | COB-ID used by PDO                |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Access                            | RW                                |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Default Value                     | Index 1800h: C0000180h + Node-ID  |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | Index 1801h: C0000280h + Node-ID  |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | Index 1802h: C0000380h + Node-ID  |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | Index 1803h: C0000480h + Node-ID  |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | Index 1804h: C0000181h            |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | Index 1805h: C0000281h            |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | Index 1806h: C0000381h            |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | Index 1807h: C0000481h            |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Range                             | UNSIGNED32                        |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+

 

  SubIndex        2
  --------------- -------------------
  Description     transmission type
  Access          RW
  Default Value   0xFE
  Range           UNSIGNED8

 

  SubIndex        3
  --------------- --------------
  Description     Inhibit time
  Access          RW
  Default Value   0
  Range           UNSIGNED16

 

+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| SubIndex                          | 5                                 |
+===================================+===================================+
| Description                       | Event timer                       |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Access                            | RW                                |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Default Value                     | 0                                 |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Range                             | 0-not used                        |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | UNSIGNED16                        |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
